whyItMatters: python XPath assembles from parts ((?:xpath|findall)s*([^)]*+), so input quotes rewrite the query.
actions: Bind values as variables with xpath variables.
If binding is unavailable, quote-escape values before interpolation.
Re-run the scan and confirm no raw interpolation remains.
verification: Rescan shows no raw XPath interpolation, and quote payloads match literally.
